name: The Camphor of the Accademia di Belle Arti Cloister
reason: Cloister of the fine arts academy, an active institution; no source shows a visitor may walk in. The group of 25 Moreton Bay Figs there is an 'insieme omogeneo' (not a collectible point).

name: The Yucca of the Mostra d'Oltremare
reason: Public park, but 6 m yucca is a tree-sized agave relative, not a remarkable tree; below the bar next to the fig (nap_028).

name: River Red Gum of the Reggia di Portici
reason: Modest girth beside the delivered Portici trees; deliver if the writing pass needs a sixth.

name: Villa Gabola stone pines (sheets 09-12)
reason: Access to Villa Gabola, Via Giuseppe Cosenza, not found (only a directory listing calling it a park); iNaturalist has six cultivated Pinus fixes there from March 2023, so the pines stand. Needs one source on public opening.

name: Ginkgo and Southern Magnolia of the Castellammare Villa Comunale
reason: Girths 150 and 220 cm, modest; same public seafront garden as csm_003.

name: Plane of Via Bernardino Rota 44 (Sorrento)
reason: Via Bernardino Rota 44 is the Grand Hotel Parco dei Principi grounds, the same address as the already-blocked kauri (02/I862): hotel guest and restaurant access, not public.

name: Secondigliano plane, Via Provinciale di Caserta 92
reason: Regional register only, last roadside plane of the Bourbon road to Caserta; address-level, not checked this pass, found while reading schede.
